references.text: Heshbon is mentioned as a city in Moab that was conquered by the Israelites under Moses' leadership.
Heshbon is described as the capital of the Amorite king Sihon, whom the Israelites defeated.
Jazer is mentioned as an area with good grazing lands desired by the tribes of Reuben and Gad.
Jazer was rebuilt by the tribe of Gad as one of their cities.
The parallel account in Chronicles regarding the Levitical cities from the tribe of Reuben, including Heshbon.
Heshbon is mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy concerning Moab's judgment.
Jazer is mentioned in the prophecy about Moab, highlighting the city's geographical and historical significance.
Heshbon and Jazer are mentioned together in Jeremiah's prophecy concerning Moab's judgment.
